candidates.text: Even when the Constitution vests in Congress complete lawmaking authority over a particular area, the Eleventh Amendment prevents congressional authorization of suits by private parties against unconsenting States.
candidates.speaker: Rehnquist
phrases: Article I cannot be used to circumvent the constitutional limitations placed upon federal jurisdiction

candidates.text: [T]herefore, where Congress has prescribed a detailed remedial scheme for the enforcement against a State of a statutorily created right
candidates.speaker: Rehnquist
phrases: where Congress has prescribed a detailed remedial scheme for the enforcement against a State of a statutorily created right

candidates.text: The majority's opinion does not simply preclude Congress from establishing the rather curious statutory scheme
candidates.speaker: Stevens, dissenting
phrases: from those sounding in copyright and patent law

candidates.text: In holding the State of Florida immune to suit under the Indian Gaming Regulatory Act
candidates.speaker: Souter, dissenting
phrases: holds for the first time since the founding of the Republic that Congress has no authority

candidates.text: The dissent's lengthy analysis of the text of the Eleventh Amendment is directed at a straw man
candidates.speaker: Rehnquist
phrases: directed at a straw man blind reliance upon the text of the Eleventh Amendment

notes: Ranks 1 and 2 are both widely quoted; rank 1 leads.
